name: Wildfern Salon
purpose: Appointment booking for a hair salon: customers pick a service and staff member, see real availability from staff schedules, book with contact details, and cancel via a private link. Admins manage services, staff, weekly availability, and appointments.
actors: Guest customer (browses services/staff, books, cancels via token link)
Salon admin (manages services, staff, weekly availability, appointments)

entities.name: Service
relationships: has many staff members through appointments
duration in minutes and price in cents

entities.name: ScheduleEntry
relationships: one recurring weekly availability window: day of week + start/end time

workflows.name: Book an appointment
workflows.description: Guest picks a service, then a staff member, picks an available time slot generated from that staff member's weekly schedule minus overlaps and past times, enters contact details, and gets a confirmation with a private cancel link

workflows.name: Cancel an appointment
workflows.description: Guest opens their private cancel link and confirms; slot becomes bookable again

workflows.name: Manage services
workflows.description: Admin creates/edits/deactivates services with name, duration, price

workflows.name: Manage staff and availability
workflows.description: Admin adds staff members and their recurring weekly availability windows

workflows.name: Manage appointments
workflows.description: Admin views appointments by status/date and cancels on behalf of customers

seed_demo: 4 services (Precision Cut 45min $65, Balayage 150min $220, Signature Blowout 30min $45, Deep Conditioning Ritual 30min $40); 3 staff members (Mara, June, Ellis) each with a full weekly availability schedule; one upcoming booked appointment and one cancelled appointment so the admin view demonstrates both states
